ecology_question: Which scale first makes the published recorded species distributions different: forest/wetland, distinct cameras within habitat, or three clock categories within physical camera; and how sensitive is the hierarchical allocation to removal of individual cameras?

observational_statistics.normalized_species_cell_fraction: for each species counts(s,c)/species N, with N recomputed for any omission
observational_statistics.interpretation_warning: order, species-specific source weights, camera versus clock class resolution matter; percentage components NOT causal ecological attribution
observational_statistics.single_camera_omission: all 11 original site codes; independently recompute both species totals, every marginal and joint TV after one camera omission, original forest/wetland label preserved
observational_statistics.conditional_within_habitat_overlap: use species counts renormalized within each habitat only as separate descriptive number; not equal to the unconditioned hierarchy loss
observational_statistics.increment_at_habitat: sum over habitats min(W_h/Nw,B_h/Nb) - sum source sites min(W_s/Nw,B_s/Nb); each habitat term nonnegative
observational_statistics.habitat_vs_camera_locus: identify source site with species-normalized excess that creates the observed within-habitat extra TV; no mechanistic attribution
